clips.title: The story
paras: In the Barrens, Strahad Farsan waits for a warlock to bring him the Tome of the Cabal and channeling rods. Together, they prepare the way to bind a felhunter.

In Ironforge's Hall of Explorers, Krom Stoutarm binds the Tome of the Cabal's tattered, mouldering remnants back together. The dwarf scholar reluctantly parts with this rare work of dark scholarship, but first secures a promise of a copy. He also passes along a fresh missive from Strahad Farsan. The tome holds the rites for breaching the Nether, though parchment alone cannot conduct the ritual.

Strahad's acolytes need focus implements to steady the energies summoned to bind a felhunter. Krom sends the warlock to the Wetlands, where Dragonmaw spellcasters carry rods of channeling. Taking the rods from the hostile orcs gives Strahad's circle the conduit it needs to control the rift and stabilize the summoned energies.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Well, ah, it's hard to let it go. But you found it, and you have more important things to do with it, of course. Just, please, be sure to mention to Strahad that I wanted a copy.
While you were out, he sent a message for you. He wanted me to tell you that for his acolytes to assist with the summoning, you'll have to acquire three rods of channeling.
He might not know where to find them, but I do! They were last used by the orcs of the Dragonmaw clan in the Wetlands. I'd check their spellcasters!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Haven't seen you around these parts for a while. Have you found the tome and the rods?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done! The Tome of the Cabal and three pristine—slightly scratched, I suppose—rods of channeling.
This will be interesting. It's been some time since a young warlock took on a felhunter to make his own.
